_doc: Rules of TerraMatch_Chile_Proyecto_Final v2.0 (sections 6.1, 6.2, 8 and 8.1). Change a value here, never in the code.

slope_p90_deg.label: Pendiente P90
slope_p90_deg.definition: 90th percentile of slope inside the 5 km window

relief_m.label: Relieve local P95-P5
relief_m.definition: 95th minus 5th percentile of elevation inside the 5 km window

rough_sd_deg.label: Rugosidad
rough_sd_deg.definition: standard deviation of slope inside the 5 km window

common_resolution_source: MOLA MEGDR 128 ppd, USGS Astrogeology (approx. 463 m)

normalization.if_both_zero: variable excluded from the comparison and reported; never an artificial scale

similarity: S = 100 * exp(-D); D = sum(w_i m_i d_i) / sum(w_i m_i); d_i = distance to [low, high] / IQR_i
coverage_min_note: share of weight present; with three equal weights it means at least 2 of 3 variables

mars.label: aridity, GPM IMERG Final V07, mean 2001-2024 <= 250 mm/yr (primary source, doc v2.0)

validation.rule: Report the real outcome. Never change results to match expectations.

chile_dem.min_valid_elevation_note: pixels <= 0 m (ocean in the ASTER mosaic) are no data, so coastal windows are not read as flat terrain
chile_dem.window_min_valid_note: a 5 km window with less than 50% valid pixels gives NaN (no coverage), never a low or high value

mars.label: complementary: CR2MET v2.0 2001-2019 with IMERG fallback <= 250 mm/yr

moon.label: complementary: volcanic sequences of any age (broad criterion)

sites_rule: Sites are taken only from verified polygons in data/chile/sites/<id>.geojson. A site without a polygon is 'pending_geometry': no cells, no score, its validation check is reported as pending (passed = null). No circles or annuli are generated.
